_: Hand transcriptions of tables and graphs that PDF text extraction cannot recover.

The distance-learning table is printed with corrupted cells in the PDF itself (0?.62, 7?, ?8).
Its true values are determined by arithmetic and were checked three ways: the frequencies sum
to 50, every relative frequency equals frequency/50, and the cumulative column is their running
The box plot five-number summaries were taken from the vector coordinates in the PDF rather
than read by eye, against the axis ticks at 18 and 34. (page 3)
Form A asks the interval question at 10 and the skew question at 9; Form B swaps them (19 is the interval question, 20 the skew one). (pages 3 and 10)

[TABLE]
Name | Commute Method | Today's Commute Time (minutes) | Mean Commute Time (minutes) | Standard Deviation
Bart | BART | 24 | 30 | 4
Cal | CalTrain | 34 | 40 | 3
Dave | Drive | 15 | 20 | 5
[/TABLE]
deanza-exam1-spring2015-A13.stem: Whose commute time today is relatively fastest in comparison to his usual commute time?
